create_discrete_identity_tokenizer: create a DiscreteIdentity tokenizer instance with a specified number of classes for discrete trajectory encoding
encode_discrete_trajectory: encode a discrete trajectory tensor into a one-hot encoded float32 tensor using the DiscreteIdentity tokenizer
decode_discrete_trajectory: decode a one-hot encoded trajectory tensor back to discrete class indices using argmax
create_tokenizer_from_dataset: create a DiscreteIdentity tokenizer from a dataset key and class count using the create class method
check_discrete_property: check the discrete property of a DiscreteIdentity tokenizer to confirm it returns True
